justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: Held predominantly by people already in health IT; modest lift for new entrants but a useful signal for consulting and PM roles.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Cited in HIMSS-member consultancy and IDN postings but rarely required at Epic/Oracle Health, who prioritize their own application certs.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: HIMSS compensation surveys show a consistent 15-25% premium over non-certified peers at similar experience.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Breadth-oriented (governance, workflow, privacy, management) rather than deep technical build/config skill.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Eligibility requires 3-5 years prior health IT experience, so most bedside PT/OTs cannot sit for it without first working in informatics.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Single exam (~$500 member fee) with self-study prep is cheap and fast once eligibility is met, but the experience gate lowers accessibility.
